items.claim: CFO 給出 Q3 營收指引區間
items.quote: in the range of $1.15 billion and $1.2 billion
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 給出 Q3 非 GAAP EPS 指引區間
items.quote: we expect non-GAAP EPS to be in the range of $3.45 to $3.60
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明 Q3 各業務線皆預期成長（除汽車外）
items.quote: grow sequentially in telecom, datacom and HPC
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 揭露 Q2 毛利率數字
items.quote: Gross margin in the second quarter was 12.4%
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 揭露 Q2 營業利益率數字
items.quote: Operating margin reached 10.9% in second quarter
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 說明匯率避險下 Q3 毛利率仍有逆風
items.quote: 20, 30 basis point headwind in the gross margin
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 稱公司在 CPO 領域自認領先多數同業
items.quote: we're far ahead of most of our competitors in the space
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明正與 3 個不同客戶進行 CPO 專案
items.quote: co-packaged optics programs with 3 different customers
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 確認公司正參與光交換器（OCS）相關專案
items.quote: we are working on a couple of projects on -- in that space
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 給出目前 HPC 專案完全放量後的營收預估
items.quote: north of about $150 million when it's fully ramped
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 承認 datacom 先進產品線仍供給受限
items.quote: we have been, as you say, supply constrained in our datacom
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明雷射二供已獲客戶核准以緩解供給瓶頸
items.quote: a second source, for the EML for the laser
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CFO 揭露 Q2 庫藏股買回規模與均價
items.quote: just over 12,000 shares at an average price of $387
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO 揭露庫藏股計畫剩餘額度
items.quote: $169 million remained available under the program
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CEO 說明 Building 10 建置維持零負債
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 澄清與 AWS 的關係非獨家
items.quote: our relationship with AWS is not exclusive
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明公司在目前 HPC 專案中是第二供應商
items.quote: we're currently a second source in that program
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO 說明擴產策略不要求客戶簽硬性承諾
items.quote: we don't ask our customers to make a hard commitments
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Christopher Rolland 追問 CPO switch 是否推升產能規劃、對比傳統 transceiver 的展望
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先表態興奮但明確拒絕深入：「we haven't really talked about the switch -- the CPO switch opportunities in detail」「I really wouldn't want to go much deeper than that at this point」

qa_flags.question: Tim Savageaux 追問為何 HPC 放量急升下，telecom／datacom 的 Q3 序列成長看起來反而放緩
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先回應「I'm sorry, Tim, I didn't understand the question... I missed the question」，未直接回答即轉交 CFO 給出量化說明

qa_flags.question: Samik Chatterjee 追問 CPO 對公司的具體 content opportunity 與營收貢獻時點
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 只給方向性用語「the specific timings on when the revenue would become more material, depends on our customers' road maps」，未給任何數字或時間點
